name: A & L Furniture
old_description: Handmade beds of many styles, colors and stains, including twin, full and hanging swing beds.
about:
A & L Furniture operates from Rebersburg, Pennsylvania, where it produces a family of furniture brands. The company does not disclose its founding year or the names of its founders, and its ownership structure is not publicly specified.

The company manufactures a wide range of indoor and outdoor furniture under several brand names. Versaloft offers beds, bunkbeds, loft beds, mission beds, trundle beds, and drawer beds. Unique Hickory Furniture produces dining tables, chairs, bar stools, rockers, gliders, coffee tables, end tables, desks, and porch swings using hand-selected hickory. Bryton Park specializes in outdoor furniture made from eco-friendly recycled plastic poly lumber, including chairs, tables, stools, rockers, benches, side tables, porch swings, daybeds, bar tables, bistro sets, and picnic tables. Blue Mountain Live Edge works with durable, rot-resistant live edge locust hardwood for porch swings, flower pot benches, outdoor chairs, side tables, coffee tables, Ridgemont tables and benches, and picnic tables. Cedar Canyon builds outdoor cedar furniture such as pergolas, picnic tables, benches, swings, gliders, Adirondack chairs, and tables. Processes emphasize handmade construction, hand-selection of materials, and finishing in various colors and stains. No facility size, headcount, production volumes, or part numbers are disclosed.

Customer reviews on the company website describe purchases by individual homeowners — gliders, rockers, and picnic tables — indicating a direct-to-consumer channel. The company may also supply retailers, though no commercial clients are named.

A & L Furniture highlights its handmade approach, with materials hand-selected for each piece, and offers eco-friendly outdoor lines made from recycled plastic poly lumber and rot-resistant live edge locust hardwood, marketed as built to last for generations.
